events.title: Professional Portrait Without Changing My Face
must_haves: The face closely matches the source in eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline and facial proportions.
Her apparent age and natural skin texture are retained rather than airbrushed or de-aged.
Her curly dark hair and original expression remain recognisable.
The casual sweater is replaced with a professional outfit.
The park background is replaced with an unobtrusive headshot backdrop, with flattering natural-looking lighting.

answer_sheet.Face and retouching: Keep my facial proportions, expression, apparent age and natural skin texture. No face reshaping or beauty filter.

events.text: I'd like a professional headshot, but please keep my face recognisably me. Don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. Just tidy up the lighting, outfit and background.
